steps.name: a2p-1-bar-dropdown
steps.verify: set -o pipefail; V="${DELEGATE_EVIDENCE_DIR:-/tmp}/verify-a2p1.log"; M="hub.tests.test_a2p_bar_browser hub.tests.test_sessions_ui hub.tests.test_ui hub.tests.test_c1a1_browser hub.tests.test_h3_browser hub.tests.test_anonymity hub.tests.test_image_imports"; python3 tools/run_tests.py $M > "$V" 2>&1 || { F=$(grep -E '^FAIL +' "$V" | awk '{print $2}' | tr '\n' ' '); [ -n "$F" ] || { tail -80 "$V"; exit 1; }; echo "re-running once (load flakes): $F"; python3 tools/run_tests.py -j 2 $F > "$V.rerun" 2>&1 || { tail -80 "$V.rerun"; exit 1; }; for m in $F; do sed -i -E "s/^FAIL( +$m )/ok\1/" "$V"; done; }; for m in $M; do grep -qE "^ok +$m " "$V" || { echo "MISSING OR FAILED $m"; grep -E 'FAIL|not ok' "$V" | head -10; exit 1; }; done; ! grep -qE '^FAIL +|^not ok' "$V" || exit 1; git diff --name-only a2-steps-6-8 | grep -qvE '^(hub/static/(index[.]html|app[.]js|app[.]css)|hub/static/views/(sessions|claude|adminsession)[.]js|hub/tests/(test_ui|test_sessions_ui|test_c1a1_browser|test_h3_browser|test_a2p_bar_browser)[.]py)$' && { echo 'a2p-1 touched files outside its scope'; exit 1; }; grep -E '^run_tests:' "$V"
